en.vibe_problem_body: Components are scattered, so reliability drops as repos grow.
en.vibe_approach_body: Unify inventory, search, and dependency visibility in one layer.

en.why_card1_body: Rules and memory are split by default across tools.
en.why_card3_body: Power grows, but setup and review load grow too.
en.impact_card1_body: New members understand current setup faster.
en.vibe_signal_desc: Official tool behavior and real team workflows point to one repeated bottleneck: component operations break first when scale rises.
en.vibe_signal_1: Cursor docs state that memory does not carry across completions, so team-wide reusable rules and context layers become mandatory.
en.vibe_signal_2: Claude Code supports memory/settings at multiple scopes, which is powerful but increases consistency overhead as repos grow.
en.vibe_signal_3: MCP expands integration power, but project-level server and approval boundaries add operational complexity by default.
en.vibe_voice_desc: Same complaints keep repeating across teams. This section turns those exact lines into an operating flow.
en.vibe_voice_1_quote: "Why does this repo behave differently even with the same prompt?"
en.vibe_voice_1_solution: VibeSmith compares active rules, memory layers, and settings side by side to surface drift before release.
en.vibe_voice_2_quote: "Onboarding takes days because no one knows which command set is current."
en.vibe_voice_2_solution: One inventory and owner map make the current component baseline obvious on day one.
en.vibe_voice_3_quote: "MCP gave us power, but now approvals and server scopes are another fire."
en.vibe_voice_3_solution: Dependency and boundary visibility helps teams review MCP risk earlier, before rollout blocks delivery.
en.vibe_voice_footer: These scenarios come from recurring multi-repo AI operations patterns.

en.vibe_faq_1_q: Do we need to change our current repository structure?
en.vibe_faq_1_a: No full rewrite is required. Pilot rollout maps existing assets first and standardizes gradually.
en.vibe_faq_2_q: Can we use this with both Cursor and Claude Code at once?
en.vibe_faq_2_a: Yes. The goal is to keep component operations consistent across both toolchains.
en.vibe_faq_3_q: What does success look like in the first month?
en.vibe_faq_3_a: Faster setup, fewer context mismatches, and earlier detection of risky dependencies.
en.vibe_faq_4_q: How do we start without overcommitting?
en.vibe_faq_4_a: Run a scoped 2-4 week pilot on one active project, then expand only with measured gains.
en.projects_framework_desc: Use this order: who gets value first, what pain is removed, and what proof to measure.
en.home_proof_title: For teams already feeling config drift.
en.home_proof_1_body: Most teams feel drift pain after 3+ active repos.
en.home_proof_2_body: Pilot is structured as a 4-week cycle.
en.home_proof_3_body: Track setup time, context stability, and release confidence.
en.home_action_desc: No vague kickoff. Clear outcome per path.
en.home_action_1_body: See the full flow in one page.
en.home_action_2_body: Check if your current setup fits a pilot.

en.vibe_fit_title: Use it when component drift is already costing delivery speed.
en.vibe_fit_desc: Adoption boundaries are explicit so teams can decide quickly.
en.vibe_fit_good_1: Three or more active repositories share one delivery schedule.
en.vibe_fit_good_2: Onboarding quality drops when owners hand off rules manually.
en.vibe_fit_good_3: Release reviews often find dependency issues too late.
en.vibe_fit_not_1: Single-repo teams with stable setup and low contributor turnover.
en.vibe_fit_not_2: Teams not ready to assign owners for component review decisions.
en.vibe_fit_not_3: Teams expecting one-click automation without rollout discipline.
en.vibe_limits_title: What is intentionally out of scope in this phase
en.vibe_limits_desc: We prioritize measurable pilot outcomes before wider automation promises.
en.vibe_limits_1: No forced repository rewrite. Existing structure is mapped first.
en.vibe_limits_2: Cloud-wide policy automation is a later phase, not a day-one requirement.
en.vibe_limits_3: Expansion happens only after pilot metrics show repeatable gains.

ko.vibe_faq_2_a: 가능합니다. 두 툴체인 간 컴포넌트 운영 일관성을 맞추는 것이 핵심 목표입니다.
ko.vibe_faq_3_q: 첫 한 달의 성공 기준은 무엇인가요?
ko.vibe_faq_3_a: 세팅 속도 향상, 컨텍스트 불일치 감소, 위험 종속성 조기 탐지가 핵심입니다.
ko.vibe_faq_4_a: 활성 프로젝트 1개에 2-4주 파일럿을 적용하고, 측정 이득이 확인되면 확장합니다.
ko.projects_framework_desc: 누가 먼저 가치가 큰지, 어떤 고통을 줄이는지, 무엇을 지표로 볼지 순서대로 확인하세요.
ko.home_proof_title: 설정 드리프트를 이미 겪는 팀에 맞습니다.
ko.home_proof_desc: 복잡한 설명 없이, 측정 가능한 기준만 보여줍니다.
ko.home_proof_1_body: 대부분 3개 이상 활성 레포에서 문제가 커집니다.
ko.home_proof_3_body: 세팅 시간, 안정성, 릴리즈 신뢰도를 봅니다.
ko.home_action_2_body: 현재 구조가 파일럿에 맞는지 빠르게 점검합니다.
ko.home_action_3_body: 현황을 공유하면 범위 있는 실행안을 받습니다.
ko.vibe_fit_title: 컴포넌트 드리프트가 이미 딜리버리 속도를 갉아먹을 때 효과가 큽니다.
ko.vibe_fit_desc: 도입 경계를 명확히 보여줘서 팀이 빠르게 판단할 수 있습니다.
ko.vibe_fit_good_1: 활성 레포 3개 이상이 하나의 릴리즈 일정으로 묶여 있을 때
ko.vibe_fit_good_2: 규칙 전달이 수동이라 온보딩 품질이 흔들릴 때
ko.vibe_fit_good_3: 릴리즈 리뷰에서 종속성 이슈가 늦게 발견될 때
ko.vibe_fit_not_1: 단일 레포 중심이고 세팅/인력 변동이 거의 없을 때
ko.vibe_fit_not_2: 컴포넌트 리뷰 오너십을 둘 준비가 아직 안 된 팀
ko.vibe_fit_not_3: 롤아웃 없이 즉시 완전 자동화를 기대하는 경우
ko.vibe_limits_desc: 확장형 자동화 약속보다 파일럿에서 측정 가능한 개선을 먼저 우선합니다.
ko.vibe_limits_1: 레포 구조 강제 개편 없음. 기존 구조를 먼저 맵핑합니다.
ko.vibe_limits_2: 클라우드 전역 정책 자동화는 후속 단계이며, 1단계 필수 조건이 아닙니다.
ko.vibe_limits_3: 파일럿 지표가 반복 가능하게 개선될 때만 확장합니다.
